title: ERFC: about 20 of 48 positive witnesses, on the corpus the kernel was fitted to
status_plain: Excel's ERFC bits come from a proprietary polynomial that is numerically INFERIOR to correctly-rounded libm -- chaotic noise, worst residual about 6 ULP -- and OxFunc reproduces it with a piecewise correction fit. The fit was trained on the very 48 points it is scored against, with the matched anchors weighted 1e12 so the fit is forced through them exactly. About 20 of 48 match and 28 remain blocked. This is a measured shortfall on a repair-target corpus, and the whole correction-polynomial design has since been superseded: W109 found that no coefficient tables exist and that ERF/ERFC.PRECISE ARE the NSWC gratio a<1 branches themselves.

counts.build_note: Neither XMD-011 nor ERFC_EXCEL_EMULATION.md names an Excel build for the 48-point witness set. The fit is noted as calibrated against Excel values captured on Windows.
counts.ambiguity_note: The source's own tilde is retained: it writes "~20/48" and "~28 still open". Which of ERFC and ERFC.PRECISE the 48 points were captured on is not resolvable -- the document covers both and the witness table is not per-surface. And the fit was forced through the matched anchors with weight 1e12, so the 20 includes points the kernel could not miss.
